messages:
Dinesh: Heads up — p99 went up ~12% on flash-paged when interleaved KV layout + bf16 on rtx-a100 pool. Repro on canary. Profiling below.

Eva: Oof. Which model and batch mix?

Dinesh: llama-13b, seq=2048 mostly, batch=8 steady-state, kv interleave ON. Dedicated gpu pool: a100-80gb, driver 535. Converting to bf16 during kernel selection. Logs:

ci-bench-bot: run/flake-1719876543: start

Dinesh: nsys top kernels:
```
Elapsed CPU Time:   12.3ms  flash_attn_fused_forward
Elapsed CPU Time:   8.6ms   paged_attn_kernel
Elapsed CPU Time:   3.1ms   kv_gather_interleaved
Elapsed CPU Time:   2.9ms   kv_scatter
```

Ben: kv_gather_interleaved at 3.1ms looks suspicious — alignment or stride issues? Any misaligned loads?

Dinesh: Yep. memalign shows base addr % 64 = 32 for KV pages; when interleaved we see extra shuffle ops in PTX and higher L2 misses. nvprof L2
```
L2_Transactions: 1.2M
L2_Hit_Rate: 0.62
L2_Misses: 0.45M
```

Alice: Did the kernel selector fallback to fused-flash or forced flash-paged?

Dinesh: Selector chose flash-paged (heuristic: seq>1024 & bf16) — but we recently changed stride threshold from 64->128. That probably favored paged variant even when interleave causes bank conflicts.

Eva: Quick experiments to run:
- try selector override -> force fused_flash
- test interleaved OFF (separate buffers)
- run batch=1 and batch=16 to see throughput curve

Ben: Also add a cheap pre-check: if base % 64 != 0 then prefer separate KV layout. Could avoid the extra shuffle.

Dinesh: I'll run canary with selector override now. Pasting command:
```
./run_canary.sh --model llama-13b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --kv-layout separate --force-kernel fused_flash
```

(ci-bench-bot: canary job queued 1719876560)

Dinesh: Canary results: p99 improved back to baseline. fused_flash p99 92ms vs paged_interleave 105ms. Throughput stable.

Eva: Good — sounds like a selector bug. We should add telemetry to log alignment mod64 and selector decision in production to catch this.

Alice: Open a tiny RFC: selector: prefer-separate-if-kv-align-misaligned and add unit/regression test in perf-suite.

Ben: Also look at dtype path: bf16 sometimes triggers different memory packing; check pack stride in quant path.

Dinesh: Created issue #3612 with repro and nsys traces. Assigning to eng-runtime @Ben. Adding perf-runner job for batch sweep.

Eva: :thumbsup:

Dinesh: Closing loop — patch pushed to selector. Will monitor next 24h canary.
